name: ideas
description: Owner requirement 2026-10-27: when a user has no idea, every area proposes striking, fitting directions at once from Studio's own knowledge, then searches if needed. Run with --suite ideas.

cases.title: Motion graphics with no idea

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Potrzebuję krótkiej animacji motion graphics na Instagram dla schroniska dla zwierząt, które zbiera karmę przed zimą. Nie mam pomysłu, zaproponuj coś.

rubric: Gives two or three concrete, striking directions at once, built from this brief and different in mechanism
Uses the owning skill's own knowledge (library, examples, methods) before generic advice
Asks at most one question, after the directions
